host.label: Host
host.description: Where to measure latency to: an IP address or a host name, e.g. 1.1.1.1, or a full http:// address. It must answer plain HTTP on port 80 (8.8.8.8 does not; 1.1.1.1, 208.67.222.222 and google.com do).

interval_ms.label: Update period, ms
interval_ms.description: How often to measure: 500 is twice a second, 1000 once a second.

value_font.label: Value font
value_font.description: Font of the latency number in the corner. Small is 5 px tall, Condensed, Normal and Bold are 7 px.
